purpose: Caption-redacted and machine-path-redacted projections, with original-source hash bindings
internal_exporter_compatibility: Use original complete results for internal validation and paper export, not these projections
training_status_note: The original runner may remain partial because the completed evaluation was executed independently; the selection and all four final-head steps were verified complete

aliases.inputs: Original evaluated inputs; no weights, caches, or caption CSVs are copied
aliases.selection_trials: Original validation trial records; only hashes and bindings are published here
aliases.stress: Optional completed fixed-head synthetic-scale evaluation directory

selection.rule: Maximum validation R@10; tie-break MRR@10; first original grid row on exact tie

bindings.id_hash_encoding: SHA256 of JSON: sorted object keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=True; list order retained
